about: Which sentence of each familiar trait's own study (impact.py's sweep of its abstract and open full text) says how much the score says, and the figure in it. This file only chooses: impact.py keeps a pick only when its 'quote' is found in that paper's text and its 'figure' appears in that sentence. kind: variance (the share of the differences between people the study's variants or score explained), h2 (SNP heritability: the most all common variants together could explain), auc (how well a score sorts people with and without the condition), hr (risk per standard deviation of the score). Traits not listed: the study reports no such figure in its abstract or open text, or its text isn't open. Checked 2026-11-26.
